notes.title: Announcement Demo Update (07/18/2025)
notes.content:
Version : 0.0.8-demo+5056
Date Update : 18/07/2025 


Added the ability to toggle left-hand tools on/off when that tool is currently selected.

Changed the Crucifix from limited uses to a charge-based system.

Increased Crucifix movement slow effect from 30 to 50.

Fixed ghosts hearing players outside the house during hunts.

Tools stored in the inventory now drop on the ground when the player dies by possession.

Fixed guns and knives not displaying correctly at screen edge during possession.

Fixed Spirit Coin not playing sound when picked up.

Fixed placed camera not turning off when its battery runs out.

Fixed Motion Detect Camera flickering or switching views when activated.

Fixed Motion Detect Camera showing incorrect views to the player.

Fixed Motion Detect Camera freezing image when switching tools.

Fixed missing animation when switching to the same tool type.

Fixed T-pose issue when placing a corpse on a stretcher.

Fixed Motion Detect Camera detecting evidence during paranormal events.

Fixed Motion Detect Camera detecting evidence when aimed at a disappearing ghost.

Fixed Motion Detect Camera not showing ghosts on monitors or TVs inside the tent, even in darkness.

Fixed Imprison Camera not consuming film when capturing cursed objects.

Fixed Imprison Camera being usable even with no film remaining.

Fixed Imprison Camera not displaying captured results correctly.

Fixed Imprison Camera showing the focus bar even when not aiming.

Fixed bug where the camera model appears in view when photographing from a high angle.

Fixed material rendering error on the Ghost Book.

Added auto-scaling font system for PDA case details on small screens.
Adjusted spacing in PDA case details when inside Nirvana.

Fixed T-pose after using charms in tutorial mode.

Fixed hand pose issues when switching tools too quickly.
Fixed abnormal camera angle when exiting the van.

Fixed Thai lobby names not displaying correctly.

Added room code display in ESC menu.

Adjusted Dowsing Stick and Igniter tools to be placeable.

Fixed camera freezing when exorcising ghosts while using the computer.

Disabled tool switching while in placement mode.

Added microphone settings refresh button.

notes.title: Announcement Demo Update (07/16/2025)
notes.content:
Version : 0.0.7-demo+5024
Date Update : 16/07/2025 - 22:00



Improved ghost logic to behave more realistically and intelligently.

Fixed a bug with the audio player that caused display errors in certain situations.

Made EMF evidence easier to find in the tutorial for new players.

Fixed an issue where players could purchase talismans without enough money.

Enhanced UI effects for a better visual experience.

Adjusted both the hunt start time and hunt duration to scale with the ghost's haunting level.

Modified the number of ghost hunts based on the ghost's haunting level.

Fixed incorrect initial ghost health values.

Fixed display issues on the motion detection camera screen on the television.

notes.title: Announcement Demo Update
notes.content:
Version : 0.0.6-demo+5012
Date Update : 15/07/2025 - 22:00

Steam Build Id : 19231317



        The N.O.X. development team is fully committed to refining every element of the game. Our goal is simple: if the game isn’t good enough, we won’t stop working.

🔧 Updates & Fixes

Added haunting level indicator for each case

Added UI effects reduction settings

Added head bobbing intensity settings

Added focus blur/sharpness settings

Fixed player unable to move after entering Nirvana

Fixed ESC button not working on settings screen

Improved item pickup near ground inside the house

Fixed incorrect character switching

Fixed camera tool showing incorrect battery level when held

Fixed camera tool still working when battery is depleted

Fixed Phantom ghost being capturable by the camera

Fixed inconsistent photo evidence display across players

Improved fuse box room visibility in tutorial mode

Fixed incorrect charm room description in tutorial

Fixed fingerprint display issue in tutorial

Fixed motion sensor camera showing incorrect battery level when held

Fixed motion sensor detecting ghosts through walls

Fixed motion sensor detecting ghosts during a hunt

Fixed frozen display when motion sensor is placed

Fixed motion sensor on the ground not being toggleable

Fixed voice recorder showing incorrect battery level

Fixed spirit communication tool showing incorrect battery level

Fixed holy water sound stuck in inventory

Fixed salt water sound stuck in inventory

Fixed sanity potion sound stuck in inventory

Fixed flashlight not emitting light when held in left hand after dropping a two-handed item

Fixed dowsing rod sound persisting after storing in inventory

Fixed dowsing rod floating in place

Fixed gun not showing aiming animation

Fixed incorrect bullet count on ammo box

Fixed ghost fingerprints not spawning sometimes

Fixed ghost fingerprints appearing too small

Fixed house keys showing mismatched key/pair visuals when held

Fixed fire effect disappearing too quickly after player is burned

Fixed burned body showing as normal corpse when placed on stretcher

Fixed not auto-switching slots when carrying a corpse

Fixed charms still appearing after use in tutorial mode

Fixed no microphone status showing when switching to Push-to-Talk mode

Fixed incorrect time display in PDA case details

Fixed tools disappearing after disconnected player re-joins

Fixed players unable to reoccupy seats after disconnection

Fixed certain items not displaying properly in hand

🛠 Known Issues Under Investigation

Long ghost hunt duration

Ghost hunts not scary or functioning correctly

Abnormal house randomization

Tool control and usability being unintuitive

Sound design not yet effective

Need for a more comprehensive tutorial

Ghost deception not frightening enough

Voice recognition only supports English

Game performance being too demanding

Uneven lighting/darkness in environments

Inability to return tools to base

Hiding in closets is too safe

Persistent bugs reported by players
